title: Out-of-sample test of the frozen First-Mover Flow specification on a never-seen universe
looked_at_before_registration: file structure, date range, first/last normalised prices, rating counts per stock
signal coverage and the number of names with a valid composite (no returns, no ICs)

transfer_choices.primary: leg fraction 0.4 of names with a valid composite score each session: k_t = max(2, floor(0.4 * N_t)) (the development choice k = 4 of N = 10; with variable coverage the fraction is the transferable quantity)
transfer_choices.evaluation_window: 2024-01-05 .. 2026-08-05 (647 sessions) after a 252-session warm-up (target expiry 252, GJR-GARCH needs 250 observations, LMH window 126)
transfer_choices.sub_periods: two halves of the evaluation window, reported for stability

tests: net Sharpe, CAGR, max drawdown, Calmar
CAPM beta and alpha vs the equal-weight market of the 30 stocks (weekly, HAC)
factor attribution vs the four price-control books built the same way
placebos: IID scores, stock-label permutation, circular time-shift
rank IC (21 sessions) of the composite and of each signal, phase-averaged test
PSR; DSR over the two pre-registered variants
institutional comparables built with the same construction
decision_rule: No parameter is changed after this file is hashed. Results are reported as they come out.
